paragraphs: R. Chanina Kara: Berakhot 30b [received 39b], before R. Yannai, there; Yevamot 40a, near the end. “I had great difficulty with R. Chanina the Great, who did not permit me to divide the verse”: Taanit 27b; Megillah 22a.
